5.w: The sons of Japheth: Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

6.w: The sons of Gomer: Ashkenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

7.w: The sons of Javan: Elishah, Tarshish, the Kittites, and the Rodanites.

8.w: The sons of Ham: Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

9.w: The sons of Cush: Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, and Sabteca. The sons of Raamah: Sheba and Dedan.

10.w: Cush was the father of Nimrod, who established himself as a mighty warrior on earth.

11.w: Mizraim was the father of the Ludites, Anamites, Lehabites, Naphtuhites,

12.w: Pathrusites, Casluhites (from whom the Philistines descended) , and the Caphtorites.

13.w: Canaan was the father of Sidon—his firstborn—and Heth,

14.w: as well as the Jebusites, Amorites, Girgashites,

17.w: The sons of Shem: Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, and Aram. The sons of Aram: Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.

18.w: Arphaxad was the father of Shelah, and Shelah was the father of Eber.

19.w: Two sons were born to Eber: the first was named Peleg, for during his lifetime the earth was divided; his brother’s name was Joktan.

20.w: Joktan was the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, Jerah,

23.w: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.

28.w: The sons of Abraham: Isaac and Ishmael.

29.w: These were their descendants: Ishmael’s firstborn son was Nebaioth; the others were Kedar, Adbeel, Mibsam,

31.w: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These were the sons of Ishmael.

32.w: The sons to whom Keturah, Abraham’s concubine, gave birth: Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, Shuah. The sons of Jokshan: Sheba and Dedan.

33.w: The sons of Midian: Ephah, Epher, Hanoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All these were the sons of Keturah.

34.w: Abraham was the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac: Esau and Israel.

35.w: The sons of Esau: Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jalam, and Korah.

36.w: The sons of Eliphaz: Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, and (by Timna) Amalek.

37.w: The sons of Reuel: Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

38.w: The sons of Seir: Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer, and Dishan.

39.w: The sons of Lotan: Hori and Homam. (Timna was Lotan’s sister.)

40.w: The sons of Shobal: Alyan, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon: Aiah and Anah.

41.w: The son of Anah: Dishon. The sons of Dishon: Hamran, Eshban, Ithran, and Keran.

42.w: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

43.w: These were the kings who reigned in the land of Edom before any king ruled over the Israelites: Bela son of Beor; the name of his city was Dinhabah.

44.w: When Bela died, Jobab son of Zerah from Bozrah succeeded him.

45.w: When Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites succeeded him.

46.w: When Husham died, Hadad son of Bedad succeeded him. He struck down the Midianites in the plains of Moab; the name of his city was Avith.

47.w: When Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah succeeded him.

48.w: When Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth on the River succeeded him.

49.w: When Shaul died, Baal Hanan son of Achbor succeeded him.

50.w: When Baal Hanan died, Hadad succeeded him; the name of his city was Pai. His wife was Mehetabel, daughter of Matred, daughter of Me-Zahab.

51.w: Hadad died. The tribal chiefs of Edom were: Timna, Alvah, Jetheth,

54.w: Magdiel, and Iram. These were the tribal chiefs of Edom.
